snippet.title: Alias Underground: SD-6 Agent Training
snippet.description:
Alias Underground: Mission 0: SD-6 Agent Training
PC Version

A fun, free game from ABC TV website circa 2002.  It follows the TV show "Alias" on ABC TV in the early 2000's.  I recently found this game on an old storage CD and was able to install on A Windows 10 machine.  It runs through Java.

You can download the free PC version of the game from my google drive.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ZsMuloYpItiT1msZca4N-1DAj_5ELS8y?usp=sharing
